title: Casa Azul - Cozy Retreat Nashville / Old Hickory
description:
Discover Casa Azul, where comfort meets convenience. Our cozy retreat is minutes from Old Hickory Beach & the Cumberland River, and just 20 minutes from Nashville’s top attractions. With a game room, spacious living areas, and modern amenities, it’s perfect for families, music lovers, and anyone seeking the best of both city and nature.

The space
WHAT YOU'LL LOVE:

Spacious living room with an electric fireplace & 65" smart TV

Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances + large dining table

3 bedrooms with soothing coastal décor & 4 extra-comfy beds

2.5 bathrooms, perfect for families & groups

Rec room with darts, foosball, board games & more

Hamby’s Market right outside for convenient snacks & essentials

PERFECT FOR:

Family getaways or group trips

Concert weekends & Nashville events (just 20 minutes to Downtown & Grand Ole Opry)

Relaxing lake escapes with plenty of space to unwind

Book your stay at Casa Azul today and enjoy the best of both worlds—city excitement + lakeside charm!

Guest access
Whole house is yours!

Other things to note
The garage isn’t available for parking, we use that for recreation and fun for the family while you’re in town!

We strongly encourage all guests to get travel insurance to protect them from any last-minute cancellations and trip interruptions.
